messages:
alice: Starting the v1.12 canary promotion now, change window 17:00-19:00 PT. Deploybot started staging -> canary but looks like it stalled on artifact verify. Anyone oncall available?
deploy-bot: [system] Promotion paused: artifact verification failed for image manifest. Error: digest mismatch (expected sha256:deadbeef..., got sha256:deadc0de...). Full log: gs://redwood-artifacts/canary/v1.12/manifest.json -> 403 on blob rewrite attempt.
bob: I'm on. Pulling logs now. That 403 on blob rewrite usually means the signed URL expired during copy. Can you paste the exact blob path?
alice: gs://redwood-artifacts/canary/v1.12/manifest.json and the three layer blobs: layers/sha256/abc..., layers/sha256/def..., layers/sha256/ghi...
carol: Yep, looks like the blob-rewrite worker hit a 30s TTL and got an intermediate partial file. We saw a similar pattern last month when the storage pre-signed URL TTL was too low under high concurrency.
dave: If it's a partial download we should avoid promoting this image. My suggestion: pin the canary to the last-good digest and abort the current promotion. Then re-run the artifact upload with extended signed URL TTL and re-verify.
jen: Also note QA observed a staging test failure earlier that might be related: migration 20260330_add_search_index timed out on the CI worker while running heavy index rebuild. Logs show a lock wait on migrations table for ~9m.
bob: That migration timeout could have caused the artifact verification to race with cleanup jobs. Two parallel flows hitting the storage cluster + DB heavy ops is likely the root. For immediate unblock: run deploybot rollback to previous digest: sha256:0a1b2c3d and open a follow-up to re-upload and reverify in a maintenance window.
carol: Commands:
```
# pin canary to previous digest
deploybot promote --env=canary --image=registry.redwood.ai/release:v1.11@sha256:0a1b2c3d --reason="rollback after manifest mismatch"
# re-upload with longer presign TTL
artifact-upload --path=canary/v1.12 --presign-ttl=300
```
alice: Good. I'm authorizing the rollback now. Also setting a hard hold on further promotions until artifacts are reverified and migrations run against a read-replica. Can someone open release-note update and change-window note? We should mention rollback and planned re-verify tomorrow morning.
dave: I'll post the release note update and schedule a 2-hour reverify window at 09:00 PT. Also creating a follow-up ticket to bump presign TTL and add retry logic in blob rewrite worker.
jen: For QA: we'll re-run the migration locally on a replica and add a guard to run heavy migrations out-of-band from the deploy.
bob: Rolling back now. deploybot command issued.
deploy-bot: [system] Rollback performed: canary image set to registry.redwood.ai/release:v1.11@sha256:0a1b2c3d by bob. Promotion aborted for v1.12. ETA for reverify window: 09:00 PT tomorrow.
alice: Thanks team. :thumbsup: We'll reconvene at 08:50 PT tomorrow to confirm artifact integrity before kicking the change window. Tagging for a short postmortem: storage-presign-timeout & migration-lock-race.
carol: I'll add a short fix: increase presign TTL to 5m and add exponential retry to the rewrite job by EOD.
dave: Noted. I'll also add a canary-only flag to skip heavy migrations during canary promos until we have a safe migration path.
bob: Leaving the thread open for any follow-up. If we see more mismatches during the re-upload we'll escalate to storage infra.
alice: Closing the immediate promo. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
